baseline.label: baseline
baseline.method: force-stop then am start -W, 0.5s stop gap, 1s settle; cold-process launches after initialization, software swangle renderer; exploratory only

optimized.label: optimized
optimized.method: force-stop then am start -W, 0.5s stop gap, 1s settle; cold-process launches after initialization, software swangle renderer; exploratory only

interpretation: Exploratory evidence favors R8 but is not a production startup/memory gate: 10 samples, sequential run order, onboarding screen, software rendering and host contention. CPU profile is dominated by emulator render transport/kernel overhead; no app-owned hotspot justifies an application rewrite. Recomposition counts, Room query microbenchmarks, recording CPU and acoustic quality remain unmeasured. No leak claim from a single PSS sample.
